component.name: SlouchUp
component.summary: Nudges you when you start to slouch

description.p: SlouchUp watches your webcam and nudges you the moment you start slouching, so the habit gets caught while it's forming rather than at the end of the day.

It finds your face, notes where your eyes sit and how big your face looks when you're sitting well, then nags when your eyes sink or your face grows as you lean towards the screen. Everything runs on your computer; no frame leaves it.

screenshot.caption: Leaning towards the screen, with the nudge
